content: व्यावृत्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Turned away from, withdrawn from; व्यावृत्ता यत्परस्वेभ्यः श्रुतौ तस्करता स्थिता <ls>R. 1. 27</ls>; <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>. .²2 Separated from, singled out. .²3 .³({%a%}) Excluded, set aside; different from; अयमर्थोऽस्माद् व्यावृत्तः <ls>Tarka K.</ls> .³({%b%}) Not being found or existing in, absent from (frequently used in <ab>phil.</ab> in this sense); धूमो जलह्रदादेर्व्यावृत्तः <ls>Tarka K.</ls>; <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²4 Revolved, turned round. .²5 Encompassed, surrounded. .²6 Desisting, ceased from; व्यावृत्तगतिरुद्याने कुसुमस्तेयसाध्वसात् <ls>Ku. 2. 35</ls>. .²7 Split asunder. .²8 Changed; जगाम दक्षिणं मार्गं सोमो व्यावृत्तलक्षणः <ls>Mb. 12. 141. 15</ls>.
